thread:
marta (Support): Hey team, customer acme-inc reporting streaming duplication + missing final frame on Node lambda -> EventSource polyfill. They say every cold-start that triggers an auth refresh mid-stream results in duplicated partial "data:" chunks and sometimes the final "event: done" doesn't arrive.

ingrid (Customer): repro steps I ran:
1) Lambda handler starts SSE client using eventsource-polyfill (node-fetch under the hood)
2) Start streaming chat request to /v1/streams with ephemeral token from our auth service
3) After ~8s token rotate happens (we refresh token and re-invoke client with new header)
Observed: server sends chunk ids 1..N, then after reconnect we get 1..N again (duplicates). Billing shows doubled tokens. Final frame occasionally missing causing client iterator to hang.

marta (Support): Logs from acme (redacted):
[2026-02-10T15:02:20Z] stream.start req_id=rq_abc123 token=eyJ... v=0.8.4
[2026-02-10T15:02:28Z] stream.chunk req_id=rq_abc123 chunk_id=1 data_len=128
[2026-02-10T15:02:29Z] auth.refresh token rotated
[2026-02-10T15:02:30Z] stream.reconnect req_id=rq_abc123 new_conn 200
[2026-02-10T15:02:30Z] stream.chunk req_id=rq_abc123 chunk_id=1 data_len=128  <-- duplicate
[2026-02-10T15:02:35Z] stream.close req_id=rq_abc123 status=200  <-- no final "event: done"

marta (Support): Customer says this started after they upgraded to our Node SDK 0.8.4 and runtime change around continuous-batching in early Feb.

devon (SDK): Thanks, marta. Can you paste the minimal client snippet they run? Is it using the SDK helper or raw EventSource? Do they call `close()` on old stream before re-opening?

ingrid (Customer): Using raw EventSource polyfill (serverless env). Code:
const es = new EventSource(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
es.onmessage = (e) => { /* push to iterator */ };
// token rotate: call es.close(); create new EventSource(updatedUrl)

We *do* call close() before creating new instance, but in Lambda cold-start the previous connection may still be in-flight.

devon (SDK): Hmm. Two hypotheses:
1) Client reconnect path doesn't include a stable stream id so server treats new connection as fresh and replays cached prefix for correctness => duplicates if client actually already consumed previous frames.
2) Edge-case where close() races with server flush and server's final 'done' event got swallowed when we rewired the connection => final frame lost.

ken (Eng): Noted. We changed handshake/stream-ids in runtime 1.42.x to support prefix cache replays for resumability. If client reconnects without a 'stream_id' param, server assumes new session and may replay recent prefix if it thinks previous connection died mid-frame. In a Lambda cold path + polyfill race, that can cause duplicates.

devon (SDK): Workaround for the customer: include an idempotency/query param `stream_id=<uuid>` on the initial request and send the same id on reconnect so server can dedupe. Also try upgrading to SDK 0.8.6-beta where we added client-side dedupe (temporary patch).

marta (Support): Customer tried adding stream_id and duplication reduced but still saw duplicates on ~1/10 attempts. They also see the final frame missing in ~1/5 attempts. Billing team flagged a small but noticeable spike.

sre-bot: created alert SR-9643 for duplicate billing spike and linked logs (owner: eng-infra)

devon (SDK): Can you share a full request-id for a failing case (the one from logs earlier rq_abc123 is helpful). Also need network-level capture if possible (curl -v or tcpdump in a reproducible env). We'll instrument more logging on the server side around session handoff.

ingrid (Customer): I attached a small repro repo in the support ticket: lambda + eventsource-polyfill + a script to force token rotate. Repro reliably in their prod-like env.

ken (Eng): I'll triage runtime behavior. Hypothesis: our replay cache TTL/mark-as-closed is too aggressive during graceful close. Two simultaneous fixes:
- runtime: ensure when server sees client-controlled close() with a short Grace header it marks session closed and does not replay prefix on reconnection with same remote addr within 5s.
- SDK: mark streams with a local 'closing' flag and delay reconnect until server ACK or 200ms to avoid race.

devon (SDK): I opened PR #512 in SDK repo to add `stream_id` auto-gen and local dedupe + 150ms reconnect backoff in Node env. Patch also sends `X-Stream-Closing: 1` on close() so server can detect explicit client shutdowns.

marta (Support): Customer is on Node 18 in Lambda. Are we confident the 150ms backoff won't break PLG use cases?

devon (SDK): 150ms is conservative; it's only applied when SDK detects environment=serverless and EventSource/polyfill is used. We'll gate it. Also adding a telemetry flag to report occurrences.

ken (Eng): For runtime, I'll push a hotfix to prevent prefix replay when client sent `X-Stream-Closing`. That will stop duplicates even if stream_id missing. Patch target runtime 1.42.2; ETA 48h.

marta (Support): Great. Can you also add a regression test that simulates close() race and ensures final 'done' delivered to client? We're seeing the final frame drop too often.

ken (Eng): Yep. Test plan: simulate sequence -> send chunks 1..N, receive close header, race a reconnect; assert no duplicate chunks delivered and final 'done' arrives. Adding to CI.

ingrid (Customer): Will try the SDK beta and locally test the stream_id + backoff. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

devon (SDK): I'll follow up with a beta build link and include a simple wrapper that auto-attaches stream_id. Will watch SR-9643 for billing signal.

marta (Support): Marking as escalated to eng-runtime + sdk. Updating ticket with workaround steps: (1) upgrade to SDK 0.8.6-beta (2) add stream_id query param (3) optional backoff. Will follow up when 1.42.2 and SDK patch release available.

sre-bot: alert SR-9643 updated: assignees=[ken,devon], Sev=low (billing noise), watch_window=72h

devon (SDK): PR #512 merged to main, will cut 0.8.7 tomorrow. Runtime change landed on staging; rolling to prod in ~48h. I'll post here when GA is published.

marta (Support): Thanks everyone. I'll send the customer the beta and steps. Closing here once prod patch is live.
